headline: Five straight wins for Brugge, three league defeats for St Truiden
summary: Club Brugge beat Lens 3-0 in the Champions League on Tuesday and have now won 5 matches in a row. They are 2nd in the Pro League with 21 points. St Truiden have lost their last 3 league games, and Brugge won the meeting between them 2-0 at home in May. Brugge have had just 4 days to recover. The market still makes them 70.4% favourites, with a handicap line of 1.5 goals in their favour and a goals line of 3.5, where over is 50.9%. The read: a comfortable, high-scoring home win.
read: Club Brugge arrive on a five-match winning run, four days after a 3-0 Champions League win over Lens, and sit second in the Pro League. St Truiden are 12th and have lost their last three league games; the market makes Brugge 70.4% favourites, rates them about a goal and a half the better side and sees a game of roughly three and a half goals.

facts.fact: Club Brugge have won all five of their last five matches, scoring 15 goals and conceding four.
facts.meaning: The home side arrives on a five-match winning run spread across the league, the Belgian Cup and the Champions League.

facts.fact: Club Brugge are 70.4% to win, with the draw at 16.4% and St Truiden at 13.1%.
facts.meaning: The market rates Brugge's chance more than five times St Truiden's — clear favourites, not a certainty.

facts.fact: Club Brugge beat Lens 3-0 in the Champions League on Tuesday.
facts.meaning: Their second Champions League win in a week, after winning away at Inter, going straight into a league match.

facts.fact: Club Brugge are second in the Pro League with 21 points from eight games and a goal difference of +15.
facts.meaning: Seven wins and one defeat in the league — they are chasing top spot, not repairing a bad start.

facts.fact: St Truiden have lost their last three league games, conceding eight goals across them.
facts.meaning: Their two recent wins came in the cup (4-1 over Lommel United) and the Conference League (2-0 over Iberia), not in the league.

facts.fact: The market rates Club Brugge about one and a half goals better than St Truiden, with a fair handicap line of -1.52.
The main goals line is 3.5, with over at 50.9%.
facts.meaning: The market sees a high-scoring game, with four goals or more slightly favoured over under.

facts.fact: St Truiden have conceded nine goals in their last five games while allowing only 1.11 expected goals per game.
facts.meaning: The chances against them have been few; the scorelines have been bad — finishing and errors rather than an open defence.

sources.fact: Club Brugge head coach Ivan Leko said in his pre-match press conference that Lens are a very strong opponent he refuses to take lightly.
Club Brugge beat Lens 3-0 in the Champions League, their second straight win in the competition after their victory away at Inter Milan.
Club Brugge dominated Lens from start to finish in their 3-0 Champions League win, according to VAVEL's match summary.
Nieuwsblad reports Club Brugge woke up after a weak first half to beat Lens comfortably, with Sommer and Forbs named as standout performers.
Voetbalnieuws reports Club Brugge faced the possibility of being without three key players ahead of the Lens match because of their busy schedule.
Club Brugge were drawn to play at home in the last 16 of the Belgian Cup, according to Nieuwsblad's cup calendar.
Sint-Truiden played Midtjylland in the UEFA Conference League, according to BBC Sport's stats and head-to-head page.

key_points: Brugge: five wins in a row
St Truiden: three straight league defeats
